title: Gold harness stack Voktors-Mini.Dlink
description: Using only user-space tooling and GitHub-controlled execution, install/complete DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and stagewise where headless installation is supported. Add illegal-xd/delx-memory-bun as the local-first MCP persistent-memory component for DSH/Astra using documented Bun runtime and loopback HTTP/stdio mode. Do not use sudo and do not alter canonical launchd transport. Validate versions/help, build/install status, delx-memory doctor/health, DSH startup readiness, and local-provider connectivity where supported. Treat illegal-xd/WebTool-DeepSeek as client-side Chrome extension only: document optional UI integration, do not install a browser extension as a server agent. If stagewise requires interactive GUI, record NOT_HEADLESS. Then execute bounded canonical Astra runtime E2E and publish provider/model/execution/tests/evidence to the node result branch.
